## Organization

Name: North East Bexar County Democrats
Abbreviation: NEBCD
Type: Democratic political club / PAC
Founded: 1994
Description: The oldest Democratic club in Bexar County, Texas. NEBCD raises funds, organizes volunteers, and works to maximize voter turnout across Northeast San Antonio and Bexar County. Open to anyone wishing to be informed or involved in local politics.
